claim_boundary: Target-aware design followed by target-input-free execution and sealed ranking; not historically blind discovery, pristine external validation, universal superiority, candidate-level significance, or strong FWER in mixed catalogues.

physical_representation.drift: radiant-longitude, radiant-z, and log-speed displacement per degree of unwrapped solar longitude

quantization.bin_convention: origin-zero, half-open; solar and radiant longitude wrap modulo 360; pole longitude is zero

candidate_generation.anchor_rule: fixed quota of anchors from each local maximum of a recurrence-aware coarse-bin score at each scale; score orders represented years, capped annual occupancy, capped log-occupancy, then coarse-bin tuple and event ID
candidate_generation.fit_neighborhood: the occupied bin plus one neighboring bin in each of solar longitude, radiant longitude, radiant z, and log speed
candidate_generation.proposal_alias_rule: coarsen every integer lattice coordinate except scale by floor-division into blocks of two; choose the geometry-medoid proposal, then the lexicographically smallest tuple
candidate_generation.density_rank_bins: coarse zero-drift physical bins with one-bin physical neighborhoods; annual support is counted before pooled occupancy
candidate_generation.fit_member_priority: nearest normalized physical distance to the anchor, then event ID
candidate_generation.fit_failure: discard the anchor if the fitted trajectory leaves the frozen drift or physical bounds
candidate_generation.membership_family: the union of all raw proposals in the deterministic alias block; the family medoid is the reported identity

recurrence.partial_conjunction: min(1, (m-1) * second_smallest(heldout_p_values)) on the same stabilized cell family
recurrence.seed_namespace: SHA-256(method-version || normalized-endpoint-hash || null-role || randomization-index); one complete null panel is shared across candidate cells to preserve maximum-statistic dependence

null_strata.scope: observing year x broad physical source stratum
null_strata.permutation: permute solar longitudes within each fixed stratum; retain every row's radiant and speed values

stage0.discovery_solar_domain: full valid domain; no target interval is removed

fair_evaluation.temporal_holdout: fit proposals and ranking only on predeclared discovery years; apply the unchanged ranked catalogue to untouched holdout years
fair_evaluation.annual_capacity: predeclared equal capacity per year; under-capacity is recorded as an outcome
fair_evaluation.truth_usage: truth labels may be joined only after target-free ranking and projection for external benchmark metrics

frozen_rule: No scale, bin, drift bound, null transformation, randomization count, ranking key, or gate may be changed after benchmark truth is mounted.
